item.title: SongShine for Parkinson’s Honors Founder at Annual Benefit Luncheon
item.description: The SongShine for Parkinson’s Foundation held its annual benefit luncheon earlier today, honoring founder Dr. Ruthanna Metzgar.Hosted at Mission Hills Country Club in Rancho Mirage, longtime members gathered in song to celebrate their mentor and raise funds for the organization’s future. item.title: USA Men's Hockey wins first gold medal since 1980
item.description: It was the greatest hockey game we have seen in decades. Maybe ever. Certainly the fastest pace on the ice of all-time.The United States defeated rival Canada 2-1 in overtime in the gold medal game.It's only fitting it was 46 years to the day after the iconic 'Miracle On Ice' at the 1980 Winter Games in Lake Placid when the Americans upset the heavily favored Soviet Union.From the opening faceoff, the rivalry was intense. item.title: BAFTA Film Awards 2026 Winners Revealed Ahead of Oscars Race
item.description: The 2026 BAFTA Film Awards are underway in London, with the ceremony helping shape the momentum heading into this year’s Academy Awards.One of the early surprises came when Wunmi Mosaku won supporting actress for her role in “Sinners,” beating out several strong contenders. item.title: Armed Man Shot and Killed After Breaching Security Perimeter at Trump’s Mar-a-Lago Estate
item.description: An armed man was shot and killed early Sunday after unlawfully entering the secure perimeter surrounding President Donald Trump’s Mar-a-Lago estate in Palm Beach, Florida, according to federal and local authorities.The incident happened around 1:30 a.m. when officials say a man entered through the north gate of the property as an employee was exiting. item.description: Nemesio “El Mencho” Oseguera Cervantes, the powerful leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel (CJNG) and one of the world’s most-wanted drug traffickers, has died following a major Mexican military operation, officials confirmed Sunday.The operation took place in Tapalpa, a town in the western state of Jalisco.
